'''''Stormstrike''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] assigned to the defense of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Kylan DuPre]] served as a quartermaster on the ''Stormstrike''.<ref name="TLCS" />
